audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal male vocal introduces the topic with an animated and professional tone, speaking at a fast pace. Background music is an upbeat electronic track with a driving 4/4 beat and bright synth pads. (2) A sharp, high-frequency squeaking sound occurs, resembling a marker writing on paper. (3) A rapid, rhythmic mechanical clicking sound of a bill counter machine layers over the voice and BGM. Vocal continues with high intensity. (4) Vocal tone shifts to a highly enthusiastic, almost shouting pitch as money-related benefits are mentioned. BGM maintains a steady, energetic tempo. (5) Multiple short, percussive 'click' and 'clack' sounds represent battery insertion. The vocal density increases as specific tool models are listed clearly. (6) A comedic shift in vocal pitch occurs, becoming higher and more questioning. BGM texture simplifies slightly to emphasize the dialogue. (7) Final promotional pitch delivered with high dominance and clarity. Music swells in volume for the outro before a clean hard cut.
